0x0007B0.en: 「So... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007E2.en: 「Not with my skills as they are...@ this is my limit...!」

0x000A04.en: 「Is this as far as I go......!?」

0x000A3C.en: 「Oh dear...@ how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B05.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B40.en: 「No way I'm screwing up here...!@ This ain't fun...」

0x000B94.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C7E.en: 「So this is as far as I go......!」

0x000CE5.en: 「This is my limit...... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000D91.en: 「No good, I took too many hits...... Retreating!」

0x000DDE.en: 「Well, I've had it. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E1C.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000F0E.en: 「Ngh...... So I'm the falling star...... Ejecting!」

0x0010B7.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010FE.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001133.en: 「Dammit! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001177.en: 「I can't fight anymore! I'm pulling back!」

0x00121F.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x00126D.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Pulling back!」

0x001357.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001395.en: 「Well, well, this is where it ends.」

0x0013C4.en: 「I can't go on. If you'll excuse me, I'll take my leave.」

0x00144F.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull out here...!」

0x001843.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandon ship takes top priority...!!」

0x001907.en: Paris - Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001935.en: Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001967.en: 「...The Gaia Sabers violated the accord and@ launched an attack on the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x001A01.en: 「Shall we lodge a protest with Alteur Steinbeck?」

0x001A4D.en: 「No need. He has severed ties with us.」

0x001A87.en: 「Severed ties...? Don't tell me, a rebellion...!?」

0x001AC1.en: 「Alteur is part of the establishment.@ Given time and the right moment, even without force...@ he could claim this world's throne.」

0x001B75.en: 「And yet, he means to cast aside his current position@ to accomplish something...」

0x001BE6.en: 「And one of the keys to that is the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x001C42.en: 「Yes. Send them to Grand Christmas at once.@ Just as Alteur wishes.」

0x001CB3.en: 「But with Operation Icebreaker ahead of us,@ to do such a thing...!」

0x001D18.en: 「True, the Ruina and Baral are grave threats.@ You could say we humans stand at the brink of extinction.」

0x001D9E.en: 「But at a juncture like this, an establishment force@ that won't march in step with us...@ no, Alteur Steinbeck himself...」

0x001E43.en: 「I believe he could become a threat to rival@ these inhuman enemies before long.」

0x001E9F.en: 「B-but...@ the enemy we must fight right now is...」

0x001EFB.en: 「Baral sits enthroned above us, unmoving,@ the Ruina's movements are dying down,@ and the Guests can't touch the Earth.」

0x001F9A.en: 「Now is our best chance to bring Alteur down.」

0x002005.en: 「If Alteur acts on his own@ and deviates from this world's system...@ the Gaia Sabers have no further use to us.」

0x0020B3.en: 「In the postwar world, only we, the@ <Earth Federation Army>, should hold military power.@ No balance-tipping weight is needed.」

0x002145.en: 「The Gaia Sabers are not a foe@ worthy of standing against us.」

0x0021A7.en: 「B-but...@ for us Federation forces to move openly...」

0x0021F7.en: 「We let the Steel Dragon Squadron run free for times like this.@ Win, you're the army. Lose, you're traitors...@ they'll grasp that much.」

0x0022B1.en: 「Even so, with only the Hagane, a single ship...」

0x0022E5.en: 「They did the same thing in the same place during the DC War...@ but if it disrupts later operations,@ you may withdraw them.」

0x0023E6.en: (Alteur Steinbeck...@ I won't let things go as you planned)

0x0024C4.en: 「That's right... and I want you to conduct a reconnaissance in force.」

0x00250A.en: (So that's how it is, after all...)

0x002532.en: 「In other words, probe Alteur's true intentions?」

0x002588.en: 「...If the Gaia Sabers' aim isn't to seize our forces@ but to annihilate them, how should we@ respond?」

0x002664.en: 「If possible, remove them by force@ and take control of Grand Christmas.」

0x00272F.en: 「With the Earth sealed off by Baral and@ Operation Icebreaker looming,@ mounting such an operation is reckless, but...」

0x0027EF.en: 「To remove any future threat, Marshal Gaspard believes we should@ confirm the Gaia Sabers'... no, Alteur's true intent,@ and expose his scheme.」

0x0028C4.en: 「And... this operation may turn up the evidence@ to clear your names.」

0x002938.en: 「Honestly, I can't bring myself to endorse@ this dangerous operation... but whatever our intentions,@ the Gaia Sabers will come for you.」

0x0029FE.en: 「Even so, we'd rather avoid any avoidable fight.@ Beyond the Ruina and the Guests, a great enemy@ named Baral still awaits us...」

0x002AC1.en: 「Sweeping away the threats that blanket Earth's sphere@ would also show the world where we stand.」

0x002B32.en: 「...So you'd thought it through that far, Lt. Commander Tetsuya.@ Even Marshal Gaspard@ hadn't given that order...」

0x002BE0.en: 「...If Captain Daitetsu Minase were here,@ he'd make the same call.」

0x002C51.en: 「I see... yes, he would, that man.」

0x002C8B.en: 「Then, if you judge the situation unfavorable,@ withdraw at once. Your fight@ doesn't end here, after all.」

0x002D3F.en: 「...I pray for your fortune in battle. That is all.」

0x002D70.en: 「...So if you win, you're the loyalists, and if you lose, you're the traitors, is that it?」

0x002DB3.en: 「The Gaia Sabers... no, I doubt Alteur@ will settle for merely branding us traitors.」

0x002E30.en: 「Settling an old score...@ But the decision to advance or retreat is ours.@ Captain, what will you do?」

0x002E9F.en: 「...We'll go as far as we can.@ And if even then they bare their fangs...@ then...」

0x002F7A.en: 「Lord Alteur, the Steel Dragon Squadron's Hagane@ appears to be heading here alone.」

0x002FF8.en: 「Hmph... Gaspard Gillan is truly capable.@ Guarding his own position while also weighing@ the postwar balance.」

0x003094.en: 「To place us on the same scale as the Ruina and Baral...@ no ordinary soldier could manage that.」

0x003155.en: 「Also, per the report from Gamma Saver,@ the Hagane appears to carry Re-Tech machines@ and the Exexbein.」

0x003232.en: 「No...@ given how things are flowing, it's only to be expected.」

0x0032B6.en: 「Just so... now all that's left is to see which way the scale tips.」

0x0032F9.en: 「Then how about Delta as that weight?@ Doctor Tomine has also requested a sortie.」

0x00337F.en: 「What's more, this time he'll go himself.@ He says he has an effective strategy@ against the modified Jinrai.」

0x00340C.en: 「Very well, grant it. That too... is a trial.」

0x0034D4.en: 「Hmph... still too shallow.@ Don't just kick your opponent, kick through them.@ Like you're boring into the ground.」

0x00357D.en: 「Good... next is simulator training.@ That move suited to your style,@ today you'll finally master it.」

0x003670.en: 「...Axel talks tough, but@ the boy's a quick study.」

0x0036C9.en: 「Yes...@ and he's flying the RaiOh with Lune's power wrists@ and ankles still strapped on.」

0x003756.en: 「One wrong move could cost him his life...@ I'd say he's doing well.」

0x0037BE.en: 「Really something... and so is how well Axel looks after him.」

0x003807.en: 「Once he masters that single-minded, focused finishing strike...@ he'll reach a whole new level.」

0x003948.en: 「Then we intercept.@ All forward main guns, VLSM, ready to fire!」

0x00399E.en: 「Numerous objects descending from Alpha!@ They're Mass-Produced Jinrai!」

0x0039F4.en: 「Not once but twice now...@ Are the Gaia Sabers really set on@ fighting us for real?」

0x003A6F.en: 「Then we'll take them on...!@ No matter how many Jinrai they throw at us,@ we'll teach them it's a waste!」

0x003B06.en: (Hmph, so they came out. That saves me the trouble.@ Now I just have to lure him into range)

0x003B7A.en: (To be sure it goes off without a hitch, I'll play one card first...)

0x003C07.en: 「...Can you hear me, Steel Dragon Squadron?@ I am Kaoru Tomine.」

0x003CFA.en: 「I'll grant you a brief reprieve.@ Return my Jinrai and my daughter.@ Do that, and I may just withdraw from here.」

0x003DCF.en: 「Minaki... So you were with the Steel Dragons after all.@　What a shame. I took you in when you had no one,@　and cared for you all this time...」

0x003E74.en: 「You, of all people, know how I truly feel, don't you?@　Ever since Bian Zoldark judged me unfairly@　and crushed my ambitions...」

0x003F31.en: 「The feeling I poured into building the Jinrai.@　The hardships I endured for my comeback.@　Have you forgotten all of it, Minaki?」

0x004007.en: 「Leaving you at the lab was my mistake.@　Without my guidance, you'll lose your way.」

0x004087.en: 「Minaki, there's still time. Come back to me.@　You need me by your side.@　You can't survive on your own.」

0x00414B.en: 「And the Jinrai@　belongs in our hands.@　You understand, don't you?」

0x0041B4.en: 「B-But the BSK Mode...@　Why would you make such a thing...!?」

0x004216.en: 「A necessary evil. So the Jinrai can be used properly.」

0x00425F.en: 「Used properly!?@　I won't let you say that!」

0x0042B8.en: 「You just want to satisfy your own grudge!@　Minaki... this RaiOh isn't a tool for that!@　It's not yours anymore!」

0x00437E.en: 「Hoh, so you're the pilot.@　You don't look like a soldier to me...」

0x0043D7.en: 「Heh, System LIOH truly is a masterpiece.@　Even with someone like you aboard,@　the Jinrai can still be controlled.」

0x00449A.en: 「Yeah, that system@　put me through absolute hell...!」

0x0044FC.en: 「But that's already been dealt with!@　The Jinrai was reborn as the RaiOh!@　I won't hand it to you!」

0x0045B4.en: 「Touma's right, Father...@　As things stand now, the RaiOh should be used@　to save the Earth Sphere from danger.」

0x004650.en: 「If you believe that, then return the Jinrai.@ It's mine. With the Gaia Sabers, I'll use it@ to strike down the Ruina and Baral.」

0x00473E.en: 「Yeah, your actions so far prove it.@　You'll use the Jinrai to settle your own grudge.@　To destroy our Double G, that is.」

0x0047F2.en: 「Or rather, that's why you came all this way, isn't it?」

0x004866.en: 「P-Please, wait, Father!@　Pull the Jinrai back!@　If we fight here and now...」

0x0048E1.en: 「Minaki, I'm going to stop your father.」

0x004918.en: 「With my own hands, I'll knock some sense into him!」

0x004964.en: 「Come, then, if you can reach me.」

0x0049A4.en: 「Yeah, I'll come, and I'll show you!@　The heart Minaki put into the RaiOh!!」

0x004A1C.en: 「Dr. Tomine!@　I'm coming straight for you, right now!!」

0x004A78.en: 「Heh, you've entered range.@　Now I can transmit the forced-startup code@　without fail.」

0x004AF0.en: 「Now, Jinrai!@　Show them the true essence of System LIOH!@　Fulfill the real role you were given!」

0x004CDD.en: 「But System LIOH is supposed to be@　limiting its functions, isn't it!?」

0x004D61.en: 「Minaki... I saw through everything you did.@　That you removed System ZLAI@　and put System LIOH into dormancy.」

0x004E18.en: 「But for a human to operate the Jinrai,@　System LIOH can't be removed, nor can@　all of its functions be shut off.」

0x004EC9.en: 「To endure the feedback of full-body control,@　you have to use the system's registers.」

0x004F55.en: 「You're the one who designed it that way,@　and I'm the one who made you do it.」

0x004FC0.en: 「Th-then, Father... you built a forced-startup@　device into System LIOH from outside...!?」

0x00502B.en: 「That's right, without your knowledge.@　Insurance, you might say. Against anyone@　who'd try to abuse the fruits of my research.」

0x0050C4.en: 「There are conditions for forcing startup@　and taking control... and just now,@　every one of them has been met.」

0x005157.en: 「No matter how you strip out System ZLAI,@　so long as System LIOH remains, the Jinrai@　will keep on being the Jinrai.」

0x0051F6.en: 「With a trained human aboard,@　it puts even their judgment and instinct to use in battle.」

0x00526A.en: 「This is no man-machine unity. To the Jinrai,@　a human is nothing but one more component.」

0x0052D5.en: 「A human as a component... the same as the Baltoll.」

0x00530F.en: 「Hmph, System LIOH at full power surpasses@　Jurgen's ODE System, the <Gaim System>,@　and even Bian's JINKI-1.」

0x0053D4.en: 「Now, Jinrai! Fulfill the role you were given!@　Before my very eyes, destroy the Double G@　of Bian Zoldark, the man who humiliated me!」

0x00548E.en: 「And prove to the world that I@　was the superior man!!」

0x005546.en: 「We've got no choice but to stop it ourselves!」

0x005583.en: 「It's useless!　@　The S-BSK Mode won't stop even if@　the pilot is removed!」

0x0055F8.en: 「Yes, it keeps moving even if the human inside dies!」

0x00567C.en: 「Father... you said you'd@　seen through everything I do...」

0x005772.en: 「...Just in case, I built a detonator@　into System LIOH.@　To force it to stop if it ever ran wild.」

0x00589B.en: 「Y-Yeah, somehow... It cleared my head, too...」

0x0058E1.en: 「Mi-Minaki! You destroyed the system!?@　The System LIOH you and I built together!」

0x005964.en: 「Yes, that's right, Father...@　When I learned the BSK Mode existed, I...」

0x0059EE.en: 「Y-You... you said Minaki@　couldn't survive on her own...」

0x005A4D.en: 「Minaki was heartbroken...@　when she found out you'd built@　such a thing into System LIOH...」

0x005ADA.en: 「But... she didn't let herself@　be swallowed by that grief...」

0x005B30.en: 「And with her own hands she destroyed System LIOH,@　and saved me and the RaiOh...」

0x005BA4.en: 「That's... proof that Minaki can live on@　apart from you...!」

0x005C09.en: 「A brat talking like he knows anything!@　Without System LIOH's support,@　you can't move the Jinrai worth a damn!」

0x005C99.en: 「Change of plan! I'm taking the Jinrai back as is!」

0x005D1F.en: 「Of course it is!@　The DML System is a heavy yoke on you now!」

0x005D7E.en: 「You're right, it's heavy... The RaiOh...@　fighting in this thing...」

0x005E11.en: 「But I made my own choice...@　I chose to fight of my own will...!」

0x005E85.en: 「Touma, find the point where the dripping water@　strikes and bores through the rock.@　Pour all your strength into that single spot.」

0x005EF9.en: 「Man is machine, machine is man!@　Neither resist nor submit, become one body and soul!@　This is the secret of man-machine unity!」

0x005F77.en: 「Single-minded focus! Show your strike and your resolve!」

0x005FEE.en: 「Release the wrists and ankles, Touma!@　Master it, show me that move!」

0x006088.en: 「Watch, Minaki!@ The RaiOh's and my finishing blow!!」

0x00613A.en: 「Let's just call it good old-fashioned training.」

0x0061AB.en: 「The method isn't what matters!@　It's how much of yourself you throw into it!」

0x006207.en: 「A man who's forgotten the human heart@　could never understand that!」

0x00626D.en: 「But that's not all.@　No matter who builds a machine, it can't just@　show its full power right off the bat...」

0x006312.en: 「It moves and fights because someone actually@　tunes it and sends it out!」

0x00637D.en: 「Even if you built this machine,@ what's driving it now is the strength of Minaki@ and the others who tuned and rebuilt it!」

0x006428.en: 「The strength of everyone who trained me and lent me their power!@　Who believed in me and fought at my side!」

0x0064C4.en: 「But do you think that state can hold up under prolonged strain!?@　No matter how sturdy the body, it won't last!@　I'll be taking my Jinrai back!」

0x006575.en: 「I'll show you!@　This is the RaiOh's power...! The power to protect Earth!!」

0x0065E7.en: 「The ship won't hold! All hands, abandon ship!!」

0x006624.en: 「Impossible, this can't be!!@　The Jinrai! My Jinrai!」

0x0066A2.en: 「It can't be, it can't be, it can't be!@　My Jinrai! My System LIOH!」

0x006713.en: 「My system is superior to anyone's!@　To Jurgen's! To Azuma's! To Bian's!!@　Yes, I am the finest of them all!!」

0x0067C7.en: 「Just watch, Minaki!@ I will, without fail... the Double G...!!」

0x0068A7.en: 「Minaki... I'm sorry. I took your father...」

0x0068E7.en: 「...It's all right, Touma.@　To break my father's obsession, that was the only way...」

0x00694C.en: 「Besides... the moment I rebuilt the Jinrai into the RaiOh...@　the moment I severed my father's wish...」

0x0069C6.en: 「I was prepared for this day to come...」

0x006A1C.en: 「So now I'm parting with the past...@　Saying goodbye to Father and the Jinrai, and living from now on with the RaiOh...」

0x006AA2.en: （W-Wait, is she saying... with me!?@　Does that mean she feels the same way I do!?）

0x006B1F.en: （N-No... it's wrong to think that now!@　Minaki just went through a painful parting with her father,@　and here I am, thinking like this...!）

0x006BD0.en: （But someday, time will heal Minaki's heart...@　Until that day, I'll... I'll...!）

0x006C6C.en: 「I'll wait for you, however long it takes!」

0x006CA7.en: 「Ah... no!@　Forget what I just said... no, don't forget it, that's a problem too...!@　I mean, uh, well...!」

0x006D31.en: 「...Thank you, Touma.@　I don't really understand, but...」

0x006D81.en: 「From now on I'll be fighting alongside the RaiOh@　and everyone in the Steel Dragons.」

0x006DE3.en: （Everyone... huh...@　Yeah, I guess that's how it goes...）

0x006E2D.en: 「Touma... please lend me your strength too.@　The RaiOh needs you.」

0x006E9B.en: 「Gladly.@　From today, you, me, and the RaiOh are one team.」

0x006F04.en: 「I promise you, Minaki.@　I'll protect Earth with the RaiOh you built, no matter what.」

0x006F63.en: （And someday, without fail, I'll erase@　the sorrow from inside you.）

0x006FBF.en: 「...Our mission is reconnaissance in force,@ but if the Gaia Sabers push back,@ a clash with them may be unavoidable.」

0x00706D.en: 「In that case it'll be a hard fight...@　but to expose Alteur's scheme and clear@　the suspicion cast on us, I want you to give it your all.」

0x007127.en: 「...Feels like the Aidoneus Island assault@　from the DC War all over again. We weren't in that one, though.」

0x0071AD.en: 「But our forces are stronger than back then.」

0x0071EA.en: 「Storming Grand Christmas is what I want.@ With these hands I'll crush the Zentral Project@ and avenge the Captain, Foglia, and the Cry Wolves.」

0x0072BC.en: 「Yes... and settle things with Erde, too...!」

0x0072FC.en: 「Without a doubt, Murata will be lying in wait for us.@　This time will be when we sever our bond of fate@　with him for good, Sanger.」

0x0073AB.en: 「We can't afford to lose to Chienne and the others either...!」

0x0073FA.en: 「That's right... now that we've come this far...」

0x007465.en: （Grand Christmas... the place where I was born...@　My past is there...）

0x00750D.en: 「Yes... this battle won't be the end of everything...@　I understand that much, at least.」

0x00758D.en: 「...Ing, the trump card for the Exexbein@　that Dr. Omiya entrusted to you@　is almost finished being tuned.」

0x00761A.en: 「Understood.@　I'll be sure to master it...!」
